Pro Nail Tech

Your learning,
module by module.

Published curriculum from the original academy website. Confirm the current syllabus with the academy.

Your curriculum

Module 1Advanced Nail Shapes
  • Detailed study of advanced nail shapes (e.g., edge, lipstick, flare)
  • Techniques for creating and customizing nail shapes
Module 2Advanced Nail Anatomy
  • In-depth understanding of nail structure and function
  • Nail health and common nail disorders
Module 3Advanced Types of Nails
  • Advanced study of natural nails vs. artificial nails
  • Specialty nails (e.g., fiberglass, silk wraps)
Module 4Advanced Nail Prep
  • Advanced techniques for preparing natural nails
  • Nail prep for complex nail designs
Module 5Gel Polish Application Techniques
  • Advanced gel polish application techniques (e.g., color blending, layering)
  • Creating intricate designs with gel polish
Module 6Advanced Gel Extensions
  • Advanced procedures for gel extensions (e.g., dual forms, sculpting)
  • Customizing gel extensions for different nail shapes
Module 7Advanced Acrylic Extensions
  • Advanced techniques for acrylic extensions (e.g., 3D designs, encapsulation)
  • Creating custom acrylic designs
Module 8Refilling Techniques
  • Advanced refilling techniques for acrylic, gel, and poly gel extensions
  • Maintaining the integrity and strength of nail enhancements
Module 9Advanced Feet Nail Extensions
  • Techniques for extending toenails with various materials
  • Pedicure techniques for extended toenails
Module 10Form Extensions
  • Detailed procedure for creating nail extensions using forms
  • Advanced shaping and sculpting techniques
Module 11Poly Gel Extensions
  • Step-by-step procedure for poly gel extensions
  • Advantages and applications of poly gel
Module 12Gel Polish Removal
  • Advanced gel polish removal techniques
  • Minimizing damage and maintaining nail health
Module 13Extension Removal
  • Advanced methods for removing various types of extensions
  • Dealing with challenging removal scenarios
Module 14Advanced Nail Art Techniques
  • Ombré Art: Advanced gradient techniques and color combinations
  • French Tips: Creative variations and designs
  • Dotting Tool Art: Complex designs and patterns
  • Marble Art: Advanced marble effects using different techniques
  • Freehand Nail Art: Intricate designs and detailing
  • Liner Nail Art: Creating designs using fine nail art brushes
  • Floral Nail Art: 3D and detailed floral designs
  • Chrome Nails: Application and techniques for metallic chrome finishes
  • Cat Eye Nails: Creating the cat-eye effect with magnetic polish
  • Blooming Nail Art: Creating blooming or spreading designs
  • Rhinestone Art: Applying rhinestones in intricate patterns
  • Foil Art: Using foil for unique nail designs
  • 3D Nail Art: Creating three-dimensional nail art designs
  • Inbuild Art: Incorporating elements into the nail design
  • Miniatures Art: Creating miniature designs on nails
  • Spider Gel Nail Art: Using spider gel for intricate designs
  • Embossed Nail Art: Creating raised designs on nails
  • Abstract Nail Art: Expressive and unconventional nail art designs
  • Blooming Gel Art: Advanced blooming gel techniques
  • Curative Nail Art Designs: Nail art for specific themes or occasions
Module 15Nail Art Composition and Design
  • Principles of nail art composition and design
  • Creating complex and detailed nail art designs
Module 16Advanced Techniques for Nail Enhancement
  • Advanced techniques for shaping and sculpting nails
  • Creating custom nail shapes and designs
Module 17Client Consultation and Trend Analysis
  • Advanced consultation techniques for understanding client preferences
  • Staying updated with the latest nail trends and designs
Module 18Salon Management and Marketing
  • Advanced strategies for managing a nail salon or business
  • Marketing and promoting advanced nail services
Module 19Health and Safety
  • Advanced practices for maintaining salon hygiene and sanitation
  • Preventing and managing nail-related infections
Module 20Advanced Nail Care and Troubleshooting
  • Nail care tips for maintaining healthy natural nails
  • Troubleshooting complex issues with nail enhancements
Module 21Final Assessment and Certification
  • Practical and theoretical assessment of advanced techniques
  • Certification as a Professional Nail Technician
